seo.title: AI infrastructure
seo.seo_title: AI infrastructure: DGX Spark, Station, racks
seo.seo_description: We sell and install your AI infrastructure: NVIDIA DGX Spark, DGX Station or server racks, at your site, or hosted on our servers in Quebec, fully managed.

blocks.role: Promesse : la puissance de calcul chez vous, clé en main.

translation.headline: The power of AI, at your site.
translation.subheadline: We sell and install complete AI infrastructure, from a compact computer on a desk to a server rack. Installed at your site with your models, your applications, security and monitoring, or hosted on our servers.

blocks.role: Matériel : trois formats, trois photos (emplacements stables, matière en attendant).

cards.label: Desk
cards.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark.
cards.text: A compact AI computer that sits on a desk. To run your models and agents on site, without a server room.

cards.label: Workstation
cards.title: NVIDIA DGX Station.
cards.text: An AI workstation in a tower format, for teams that fine-tune or serve heavier models.

cards.label: Data centre
cards.title: Server racks.
cards.text: Rack servers sized for your workloads, installed in your room or hosted with us.

blocks.role: Deux modes ; la mention du Québec a ici tout son sens (hébergement).

translation.title: At your site, or with us.
translation.body:
At your site: we deliver, install and configure the hardware on your premises, with the models, applications, security and monitoring. Your data stays on your server. The on-premises mode.

With us: your infrastructure runs on our servers, in Quebec, and our team operates it for you. It is the simplest option when you have no server room. The hosted mode.

blocks.role: Ce qui est compris : modèles, applications, sécurité, supervision.

cards.title: The models.
cards.text: We choose and install the models suited to your uses and your hardware.

cards.title: The applications.
cards.text: Agents, virtual reception, surveillance, search in your documents: we install what you need.

cards.title: Security.
cards.text: Restricted access, updates, backups and firewall are configured from day one.

cards.title: Monitoring.
cards.text: We track the state of the hardware and services, and warn you before a problem stops you.

translation.title: Lighter: a virtual private server.
translation.body: For a first agent or an AI application, a virtual private server (VPS), that is, a server rented just for you, is often enough. See VPS.

blocks.role: Objections : format, matériel existant, entretien, coût.

items.question: Which format should I choose?
items.answer: It depends on your models, how many people use them and where your data must stay. The consultation determines it; you receive a written recommendation.

items.question: Can you install hardware I already own?
items.answer: Often, yes, if it suits the target models. We check before any proposal.

items.question: Who handles maintenance?
items.answer: We do, if you wish: updates, monitoring and support are part of the operations service.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: There is no public price yet. Two things are paid for: our services (a written estimate follows the consultation) and platform usage, in credits. Prices will appear on the Pricing page as soon as they are published.

translation.title: Let's size your infrastructure.
translation.text: Tell us what you want to run: we propose the format, the installation and the operation, in writing.
